svg.title: NCP body command admission
svg.desc: Informative body command-admission path for the UNRELEASED 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate. It shows raw bounds, authenticated currentness, one decode, digest-bound no-reuse, explicit mode rejection, ESTOP latching, semantic admission, and the body effect gate. It is not a release, interoperability, or physical-safety certification claim.
